title: Serie A title-winning managers 2016/17 to 2025/26
brief: Name the manager who won Serie A in each season from 2016/17 to 2025/26.

notes.Jose Mourinho: Jose Mourinho won 2008/09 and 2009/10 with Inter, before this board.
notes.Roberto Mancini: Roberto Mancini won three in a row with Inter from 2005/06, before this board.

checks: Every season's title-winning manager agrees between Wikipedia's list of Serie A winning managers and Transfermarkt's list of champions with their coaches. 2004/05 has no champion (the title was stripped from Juventus and not reassigned), so no ten-season window can include it. 4-slot rule checked for every window: only 2005/06 to 2014/15, 2006/07 to 2015/16 and 2016/17 to 2025/26 pass (Allegri has 4 or more in every window starting 2007/08 to 2015/16). The two windows that don't overlap are kept. Clubs: 2016/17 Juventus, 2017/18 Juventus, 2018/19 Juventus, 2019/20 Juventus, 2020/21 Inter, 2021/22 AC Milan, 2022/23 Napoli, 2023/24 Inter, 2024/25 Napoli, 2025/26 Inter.
